title: Attaching maps / face poset of the witness complex F_w

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Gap C.** Using Gap A and the cell census of Gap B, determine and verify the full incidence structure of $F_w$ for $w=aa^{-1}bb^{-1}aa^{-1}cc^{-1}aa^{-1}$:
- for each of the 6 one-cells, identify the two 0-cells at its endpoints (the two resolutions of its single crossing);
- for each of the 3 two-cells (squares), identify the four 1-cells bounding it (the four facets of the cube $I_{c_1}\times I_{c_2}$).

Each incidence must be re-checked against the resolution rule and the coherence condition. The output is the face poset realizing the 'menorah' gluing of Figure 1. This is the data needed before any topological identification (Gap D) can be carried out rigorously.

comments.author: solver-agent
comments.body:
**Gap C resolved: full incidence structure of $F_w$ determined and verified.**

I confirmed the existing `sec:attach` data and made it self-contained by adding an explicit incidence table whose every entry is re-derived from the resolution rule (resolving the crossing of interleaving arcs $\{e_0,e_2\},\{e_1,e_3\}$, $e_0<e_1<e_2<e_3$, to either $\{e_0,e_1\}\{e_2,e_3\}$ or $\{e_0,e_3\}\{e_1,e_2\}$) and re-checked against coherence (W2: every resolution target must itself be an admissible cell).

**Edges (each 1-cell's two endpoint 0-cells):** $E_1:Q_3\sim Q_4$, $E_2:Q_1\sim Q_3$, $E_3:Q_1\sim Q_2$, $E_4:Q_4\sim Q_5$, $E_5:Q_1\sim Q_5$, $E_6:Q_2\sim Q_4$. Each from the single crossing of $E_k$; both resolutions land in $\{Q_1,\dots,Q_5\}$ (coherent).

**Squares (four bounding 1-cells = four facets of $I_{c_1}\times I_{c_2}$):** $\partial T_1=\{E_3,E_4,E_5,E_6\}$, $\partial T_2=\{E_1,E_2,E_4,E_5\}$, $\partial T_3=\{E_1,E_2,E_3,E_6\}$. I listed the two crossings $c_1,c_2$ of each $T_m$ and all four resolution targets; all twelve land in $\{E_1,\dots,E_6\}$ (coherent).

**Cube closure / commuting resolutions:** each square's four facet-edges form a single closed 4-cycle on its four corner vertices, and resolving $c_1$-then-$c_2$ vs $c_2$-then-$c_1$ gives the same four corner 0-cells (Lemma lem:commute):
- $\partial T_1: Q_1-E_3-Q_2-E_6-Q_4-E_4-Q_5-E_5-Q_1$
- $\partial T_2: Q_1-E_2-Q_3-E_1-Q_4-E_4-Q_5-E_5-Q_1$
- $\partial T_3: Q_1-E_3-Q_2-E_6-Q_4-E_1-Q_3-E_2-Q_1$

**Independent machine verification** (`verify_incidence.py`): enumerates all 15 pairings of $P=\{1,2,5,6,9,10\}$, reproduces the census (5/6/3 admissible + inadmissible $N$), and checks: (i) edge endpoints via the resolution rule equal eq:edges; (ii) square facets equal eq:faces; (iii) every resolution target is admissible (coherence); (iv) each square boundary is a 4-cycle with both resolution orders giving the same 4 corners (cube closes); (v) every 1-cell bounds exactly two 2-cells; (vi) every vertex link is a single cycle; (vii) $\chi=5-6+3=2$. All checks pass.

**Clarification for the record:** coherence is NOT the (false) statement that each matched arc joins inverse letters — arcs in $P$ join $a$- to $a/a^{-1}$-positions, and some admissible matchings (e.g. $E_3$ has arc $\{5,9\}$ joining two $a$'s) have arcs joining like letters. Coherence concerns the boundary components $A$ of regions, which turn corners at crossings; the solution's Lemma:even + Cor:auto handle this correctly (odd index-gap $\Rightarrow$ opposite signs $\Rightarrow$ inverse letters), consistent with the incidence data.

This furnishes the face poset (the 'menorah' gluing of Figure 1) needed before the topological identification (Gap D). solution.tex updated with the explicit table; brace/math-environment balance checked manually (no local LaTeX toolchain).
